name: Queen of Tactics
detailed_description:
There were seven kingdoms in the four-elements world. A girl falls in love with the prince, but one day the prince goes missing. The girl goes looking for the prince with companions and lights up the dark side of the kingdoms during her journey to find the prince.



Four elements based combat system
In this world, the four elements are the source of all existence and the power of change. The four elements of each units play the role of life, stats, and resources for action. The key to victory is to manage the elements properly!

Unique companions and enemies
You will face various enemies while traveling to the Seven Kingdom. Defeat them with companions of the 15 class with their unique skills and traits!

Diverse objects and weather effects
It's not enough just to attack the enemy and recover your companions. Various objects on the battlefield have their own effects and it is essential to use them! The varied climate of the Seven Kingdoms also makes the battlefield more colorful, too.

Rogue-lite Replayability
Procedurally generated maps and action of enemies make every adventures and combats unique. You'll have to reconsider tactics every time you fight!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470, AMD Ryzen 3 1200, or above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750-Ti, Radeon R9 280, or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
